body.x: GoPro(ko.gopro.com) introduced its action cam Hero 5 and Session at Korea Electronics Show 2016, which runs Oct. 26-29 at COEX.

They are waterproof cameras that can take 4K video images at 30fps. It features sound, image stabilization, and distortion modification for better picture quality and it automatically saves the image files in the cloud.

Hosted by MOTIE and organized by KEA, KES 2016 is the major international electronics and IT trade show in Korea where the convergence solution in the leading fields like electronics, ICT, semiconductors, and display and industry and IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education, smart factory, and e-health is displayed.
